summary:
Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the repository, without committing and without running any tests or repository code.

Changes:
- rich/progress.py: added TimeElapsedColumn between BarColumn and TimeRemainingColumn; added Task.finished_time (defaulted field after _get_time, before visible); Task.finished now means a finished time is present; Task._reset clears finished_time; Progress.update and Progress.advance capture elapsed once inside the lock when completed >= total and no finished time is present; Progress.reset clears finished_time before refresh.
- rich/default_styles.py: progress.elapsed set to yellow.
- rich/palette.py: Palette.__rich__ returns a Table (index, RGB, Color columns; title "Palette"; caption "<n> colors" right-justified; highlight on). Table, Color, Style and Text are imported inside the method; Table is imported only under TYPE_CHECKING.
- tests/test_progress.py: added test_time_elapsed_column (unstarted, running, finished states via public update and a manual clock); added TimeElapsedColumn to the import and to test_columns after TimeRemainingColumn; regenerated test_columns expected output.
- tests/test_palette.py (new): test_rich_cast.
- CHANGELOG.md: new [Unreleased] section with Added entries for Progress.TimeElapsedColumn and Palette.__rich__.

Verification status:
- No tests were run, per instructions. The test_columns expected string was derived by tracing clock reads by hand (foo/bar start reads #0 and #11, start-frame elapsed 0:00:37 and 0:00:36, captures at reads #56 and #60 giving 0:00:45 and 0:01:00, speeds 9/7 and 12/8 both shown as 1 byte/s). Bar widths were recomputed to 25 (start frames) and 16 (final frames). The base layout model was checked against the existing expected output (33 and 23 cells). Anchored grep counts confirm the edited expected string has the new widths and the elapsed cells, and no old widths remain. The derivation is unverified by execution.
- Open risk: if the trace contains an error, test_columns will fail on the first real run.</summary>
